release.content: pubkit 0.14.2 was released on 2026-10-26 from commit e806a94ca10001d4db2bfd0d8184013638c17b04 with these changes.

rows: A repository can say how it is protected in its own pubkit.json, "protect": {"checks": [...], "tags": false}. pubkit protect reads it from GitHub for a repository protected.json does not list, and from ./pubkit.json when run inside a repository with no list and nothing named. A block, or a protected.json entry, is refused before GitHub is asked when its checks are not a list of distinct names, its tags are not true or false, it has another key, or its file is not JSON; a named repository must be OWNER/NAME, and protected.json may list a repository only once
